assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only mushoku-tensei:norn@light-novel#character-model, the canonical Norn bounded reconstruction model (generation V1, revision 1.3) at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the locked Japanese light novels V01-V15, with direct Norn grounds in the V10 retrospective departure and escort, V11, V12, V13 and V15. The model routes its observations to an evidence index, a shared state ledger, a V11 checkpoint, per-volume deep readings and checkpoint syntheses, none of which is curated on this subject or used as evidence here. The project's current-state entrypoint was read for method and gate state only. No web novel, later light-novel volume, adaptation, performed voice, reception or remembered-future material is in scope.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: The model's eleven selectors MT-NOM-ST01 to ST11: the V10 retrospective departure, escort and arrival (ST01); V11 schooling, comparison and withdrawal (ST02), independent reflection, the room encounter and later learning (ST03), the rescue appeal and her brother's departure (ST04) and, one month later, worry, church practice and the Cliff conversation (ST05); V12 the death report, grief and support for Aisha (ST06) and the marriage objection with continued attachment and requested lessons (ST07); V13 sword learning, privacy, authorship and birthday (ST08) and disclosed council work (ST09); and V15 her question about the departure with a preserved marriage objection (ST10) and learning from Eris with resistance to a schoolmate's pressure (ST11). No selector covers V14. She is a dependent child whose exact age the model declines to compute; no earlier state acquires later knowledge, and nothing after V15 is established.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The model gives six conditional rules (MT-NOM-001 to 006): relationship-specific felt safety distinct from understanding when a protector may be lost, comparison and knowledge gaps read as unattainable acceptance, reconsideration of another's conflict through her own hurt, self-chosen learning under a manageable opportunity, urgent family rescue beyond her capacity followed by worry about costs, and selective uptake of an inherited practice, each with a countercase and a stated falsifier, plus an explanatory section that refuses to explain her through inferiority or love for her brother alone. B is not supported because the model itself records that the triggers of rules 002 and 003 recur in no later volume, rule 006 rests on one extended V11 cluster (V11:032-034), mechanism confidence is moderate and all checks are retrospective under disclosed franchise familiarity. Falsifiable rules with countercases and an explicit distinction between understanding and felt safety exceed a descriptive profile, so D is not supported.

Eleven selectors run from the V10 retrospective departure (ST01) to V15 (ST11), each tied to locators or ledger sections (S155, S165-167, S191, S204-205, S246), with leakage bars: ST03's confidence is not put into ST02, no state gets the reader's full travel knowledge, the V11 reflection precedes the room encounter, and the V13 council work predates its disclosure. B is not supported because the selectors are one-line cells, no state covers V14 and later transitions are carried by per-rule qualifications that mostly report the absence of a fresh test; a sequence with per-state knowledge limits exceeds an undifferentiated profile, so D is not supported.

The model characterizes her written speech only in prose: guarded with the feared brother, requesting help and setting a boundary with the later trusted brother, courteous replies to Cliff with stated disagreement and precise follow-up questions, and silence and tears that need their context rather than a stock timid voice. It quotes no wording, self-reference or ending and lists acoustic delivery as unknown, so D is not supported; the register is affirmatively differentiated by relationship, so NOT_ASSESSED would ignore it.

Located ordinary items include choosing dorm life, making friends and protecting their privacy, asking for a regular teaching hour and later sword instruction, contributing material for the Ruijerd book, prayer practice, a birthday and long-established council work (V11:003/011, V12:031, V13:008/014/020/022/032, V15:025). The model names friendship, study, heard stories, writing and prayer as the supported interests and says other leisure tastes are unknown, and each item is a clause, so C is not supported; distinct located ordinary acts across four volumes exceed a single mention, so E is not supported.

The model makes the interlocutor a required input (who feels safe, which facts she has) and locates differentiated responses: Paul as the experienced protector (V10:030-032) and later loss (V12:026); Ruijerd as trusted escort; Rudeus first feared, then trusted enough to ask help from and refuse (V11:009-011, V13:020); Aisha, whom she criticizes and later helps to speak (V12:027); Sylphiette, for whom she wrongly speaks (V12:029-030); Cliff, to whom she replies courteously while challenging his tone and lesson (V11:032-034); Eris, whom she learns from and accepts as a person while dissenting from the marriage (V15:025/027); and a schoolmate whose pressure she resists (V15:035). B is not supported because the later responses are clauses and several are qualified as untested near analogs; differentiated responses across several attested recipients exceed a single relational sketch, so D is not supported.

The model treats explicit interiority as direct evidence and analyzes it as sequence rather than label: fear rooted in remembering Rudeus strike the person she trusted, permission felt as indifference (V11:007/009), private reconsideration of his old conflict through her own hurt before he reaches her room (V11:009-010), self-blame about his possible death and Sylphiette's suffering (V11:032-033), and relief at prayer followed by doubt that it helps (V11:032-034). It bars exact invented inner sentences. B is not supported because the rendered interiority is concentrated in V11 and later volumes supply mostly acts; scene-level inner sequence with a stated order of change exceeds attributed motives, so D is not supported. This is the claim closest to D: a reviewer may weigh the V11 concentration as D.

Located conflict items are resistance to separation (V10:030-032), withdrawal and requests for distance under fear (V11:009), pressing a capable relative for a rescue (V11:016), objecting to Cliff's dismissive tone and lesson (V11:032-034), maintaining a marriage objection while overstepping into speaking for Sylphiette (V12:029-030) and again in V15 (V15:027), refusing unwanted affection (V13:020) and resisting a schoolmate's pressure (V15:035). The model has no rule for conflict as such and records that the withdrawal trigger is not repeated after V11, so C is not supported; repeated located disputes across four volumes exceed local evidence, so E is not supported.

The model locates morally weighted positions: challenging the moral of Cliff's scriptural example before adopting effort followed by prayer (V11:032-034), worry about her causal role in another's danger that the model refuses to make a verdict (V11:032-033), a religious objection to plural marriage held with a demand that Eris be treated well, separating persons from rule (V12:029-031, V15:027), and asking whether a dangerous departure is avoidable (V15:018). Positions and their costs are shown, but the weighing beyond the V11 church cluster is a clause per volume, so C is not supported; repeated located positions with countercases across three volumes exceed a single mention, so E is not supported.
The model locates no humor or play for her, and absence of evidence establishes neither a trait nor an inability.

One curated item: a compact model (revision 1.3) covering the V10 retrospective and V11-V13 and V15 through six rules, eleven selectors and seventeen retrospective checks, with observations routed to an evidence index, a shared state ledger, a V11 checkpoint, deep readings and checkpoint syntheses that are not curated on her row. The model declares itself BOUNDED_PROVISIONAL with no clean holdout and names adult life, general clinical response, broad political judgment, combat and unfamiliar religious disputes as INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, and no selector covers V14, so C is not supported; systematic coverage of the volumes in which she is a direct subject exceeds limited local evidence, so E is not supported.

The model locates affirmative limits and countercases: an attempted journey she cannot plausibly perform and lack of adult expedition capacity (V11:016/020), missed school basics (V11:007), criticism of Aisha and occasional exclusion of others from sympathetic thought, accurate help to Aisha beside overreach in speaking for Sylphiette (V12:027/029-030), prayer whose relief gives way to doubt (V11:032-034), refusals that show affection does not grant access (V11:011, V13:020) and a marriage objection that attachment does not dissolve (V12:031, V15:027). Each limit is a clause and calibration is retrospective with prior familiarity, so B is not supported; located failures and countercases across four volumes exceed bare gap statements, so D is not supported.

Each selector is bound to a volume and locators, the model keeps audience ceilings (Rudeus does not know the account she gives the reader; her belief he will not hit her is an appraisal, not a prediction), preserves the order of reflection and comfort, and declines to reconstruct her exact age from uncertain travel intervals. B is not supported because selectors are one-line labels, no dates or ages are given and V14 has no state; D is not supported because knowledge is bounded per state rather than given as a loose period.

scenario_readiness.note: The model characterizes her register only in prose, differentiated by relationship, and quotes no wording; it lists acoustic delivery as unknown and forbids a stock timid voice. CONDITIONAL would generate speech from a prose register description; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the characterized register.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: Any single named selector MT-NOM-ST01 to ST11 between the V10 retrospective departure and V15, with that state's knowledge only; no V14 state, nothing after V15, no computed age and no later knowledge in an earlier state.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Only attested recipients in their state-specific relation: Paul as protector, Ruijerd as escort, Rudeus as feared and later trusted brother, Aisha as sister, Sylphiette as sister-in-law, Cliff as religious interlocutor, Eris as teacher and household member, school friends and the V15 schoolmate.
setting_constraints: The travel, school, dormitory, church and household settings of the Japanese light novels V10-V13 and V15
No adult life, combat, political leadership or unfamiliar religious dispute
No clinical diagnosis, universal trauma response or inferred romance
Near-analog situations only; materially novel contexts end in abstention

scenario_readiness.note: The model permits D0 represented behavior and only D1 near-analog extension within named states and relationships, keeps all admitted domains BOUNDED_PROVISIONAL, requires abstention in unsupported contexts and lists adult life, clinical response, political judgment, combat and unfamiliar religious disputes as insufficient evidence; two of six rules have no post-V11 test and calibration is retrospective. CONDITIONAL would extend a near-analog license to materially novel contexts the model declines; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore its explicit application bounds.

conditions: Only learning requests, peer and family privacy, and refusals of particular contact in attested school, dormitory and household settings, as near analogs.
Affection or gratitude grants no blanket access or agreement, and gratitude is not romance.
No talent, achievement or completed skill is generated from effort or praise.
The selected state's knowledge only; output is behavior described in prose and no quoted speech is generated as canonical.
scenario_readiness.note: Rule 004 is the domain the model extends most consistently and names among its BOUNDED_PROVISIONAL domains as ordinary learning and peer boundaries: requesting a teaching hour and friend privacy (V11:011), requesting sword teaching while dissenting (V12:031), wanted but bruising lessons with privacy, authorship and refused affection (V13:008/014/020) and precise instruction with resistance to pressure (V15:025/035). Readiness is conditional because the cells are compressed, other leisure tastes are unknown and the countercases are retrospective. READY would treat compressed rule cells as a social model; NOT_READY would deny the learning-and-boundary behavior the model extends in four volumes. A reviewer may prefer NOT_READY, given the D grade on mundane behavior.

The evidence locates positions with attributed reasons (the challenged scriptural lesson, the marriage objection held with personal regard, self-blame refused as a causal verdict), but the rendered weighing is one V11 cluster and later items are clauses; the model names unfamiliar religious disputes as insufficient evidence. CONDITIONAL would supply deliberation the model does not show; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located positions.

No romantic relationship of hers is in evidence; the model bars inferring romance from admiration of a protector or gratitude for a defense, and absence of evidence establishes neither readiness nor incapacity.

The only work-like item is long-established council participation disclosed in V13 (V13:032), and the model lists unfamiliar leadership and broad political judgment as unknown or insufficient; she is a dependent child. CONDITIONAL would build a professional domain from one disclosure; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located council work.

known_limits.statement: Understanding the reasons for a separation does not mean she feels safe with it; felt safety is relationship-specific and changes through observed care, not argument.
Her V11 reconciliation is distributed: her own reflection precedes Rudeus's visit and his uncertainty, not a single speech, permits the change; no sole-rescuer or instant cure is modeled.
Renewed affection does not grant access or agreement: she refuses to introduce her friends, refuses unwanted affection and keeps her marriage objection.
She is a dependent child with limited resources: the rescue journey she attempts is beyond her capacity, and her exact age is not computed.
Her worry about causing Rudeus's danger and Sylphiette's suffering is attention to others' costs, not a finding of causal or moral responsibility for adult decisions.
She criticizes Aisha, sometimes leaves others out of sympathetic thought and overreaches when speaking for Sylphiette; she is not uniformly considerate or accurate.
Prayer gives relief that gives way to doubt; her practice is chosen and questioned, neither credulous nor rejected, and no supernatural effect or permanent relief is modeled.
Admiration of a protector and gratitude for a defense are not romantic desire.
The model records that the public-comparison withdrawal trigger and the private family-reconsideration scene recur in no later volume; rules 002 and 003 are V11 findings, not tested patterns.

All seventeen checks are retrospective fits with disclosed prior franchise familiarity, not clean holdouts or numerical prediction scores; scene confidence is high and mechanism confidence moderate, and no domain is DOMAIN_READY.

The evidence index, shared state ledger, V11 checkpoint, deep readings and checkpoint syntheses to which the model routes its observations are not curated on this subject, so its locators were not rechecked here and no independent reconstruction test is in the evidence set. Missing support is not evidence of absence.

Adult life, general clinical response, broad political judgment, combat, unfamiliar religious disputes, other leisure tastes and leadership are not established; this is a gap, not evidence of incapacity.
No wording, self-reference or acoustic performance is in evidence; register is described only in prose.
Direct grounds begin with the V10 retrospective, no state covers V14 and nothing after V15 is in evidence; earlier and later states, knowledge and outcomes are not assessed.
